sentences.japanese: 私はひざを曲げずに両方の手のひらを床に付けることができる。
sentences.english: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.

sentences.japanese: 傷を付けたのは私だけど、こんなの簡単に直せる傷よ。
sentences.english: I was the one who scratched it, but this kind of scratch is easy to fix.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼女の無邪気さに付け込んではいけない。
sentences.english: You must not take advantage of her innocence.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼の寛大な性格に付け込むべきではない。
sentences.english: You should not play on his generous nature.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼の寛大な性格に付け込まない方がよい。
sentences.english: You had better not play on his generous nature.
